atoms.a: Aurelia wants to learn more about the classes at her new school.

instruction.text: Lies dir den Text durch und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.a: At her old school Aurelia had 26 classmates. How many pupils will be in her class at KBS?
Aurelia struggled with chemistry at her old school. What does KBS do to help her?
b: KBS gives a lot of homework.

atoms.a: Who can get private tutoring at KBS?
b: pupils that have the best marks

atoms.a: Aurelia didn't have to pay a school fee at her old school. How much is the school fee at KBS?
b: There are no school fees at KBS.

atoms.a: Aurelia's family can't afford the school fee at KBS. What does she have to do when she wants to apply for a scholarship?
b: ++She must take an exam at KBS.
She must write an essay and send it to the headmistress.

atoms.a: Does she meet the headmistress when applying to KBS?
b: No, only when she has been accepted.

b: on the east coast of England

What do they do at the summer festival?
b: ++They take part in different activities on the campus.
They watch a film at the cinema.
They have a volleyball match at the beach.
